audit.whatIsWrong: The level 3 flip was asserted without the cooldown that creates it.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit (E) is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — by far the longest escape in his kit. A spent Relentless Pursuit is a 16-second window in which he has no way out of an Infernal Chains pull; that is the entire matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: His passive was written as a "double-tap" without its name.
audit.why: Riot names it Lightslinger, and its relevance is that every ability turns into a double shot — so his burst arrives in pairs and his poke cadence is set by Piercing Light’s 9s rank-1 cooldown, not by his autos.
audit.corrected: early now names Lightslinger and gives the 9s Q cooldown.

edits.before: This is a losing start and the win[] says so: Lucian owns levels 1-2. His Piercing Light (Q) out-ranges you, his passive double-tap chunks you after every ability, and Relentless Pursuit (E) lets him dash in for a combo then dash out before your slow Q pattern can punish. Do not try to trade back rawly at 1-2 — you'll lose those exchanges. Use your E charges to dodge his Q and soak minions, give up a little CS if you must, and survive to your level 3 spike.
